quest.title: Pushing On
quest.description: After some waiting, the Mystic Onmyou Chamber has finished rearranging itself. You prepare to meet up with Xinyan and enter the Chamber once more to help Shiki Taishou regain its memories...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Kujou Sara has arrived. She's right over there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's with all the rushing back and forth? Guess she doesn't trust us after all... She sure does seem on high alert.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's just trying to take responsibility.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: The situation's getting complicated. Let's have a word with her first.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Thank you again for your help this entire time.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I've brought reinforcements. It would seem that the most critical moments are behind us, so from here on out, if we can hold this path, we should be able to repel the monsters. If any do escape, we can corner them in the Araumi region.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: The loud noises we heard earlier were probably the result of large numbers of mechanisms... We're ready and waiting for an opportunity to storm the Domain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't you station troops closer to the Domain?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: In our last operation, our samurai didn't think to maintain a certain distance. When the monsters suddenly attacked, they had no choice but to beat a hasty retreat.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Once is an oversight, twice would be a grave error. I won't allow such things to happen again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets it now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Good, that means we have an opportunity.)

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I will return to the Kujou Encampment and plan our defenses for the other regions.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: It took some time, but the Tenryou Commission has assumed full control of this area. With all my heart, I thank the three of you for your assistance. Your promised rewards are not forgotten.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Miss Xinyan, please take this letter. Enclosed is a travel permit that I processed personally for you.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I applied for the longest duration available. I hope you can use this time to really get to know Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I've also arranged your accommodation. Simply follow the instructions in the letter when you're back in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh, wow! Free boardin' and unlimited travels across Inazuma!? I don't know what to say!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: It's the least I can do.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Thank you Ma'am! I know you're real busy, but if you do get a day off and I'm still here in Inazuma, please come and see one of my street performances!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Haha, I must tell you that I never did develop much of a taste for songs and music... But given everything you've done for the Tenryou Commission, I will certainly attend your performance if the opportunity arises.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's Xinyan's biggest worry taken care of!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Not quite, my biggest worry is still Shiki Taishou! What comes next has nothing to do with me. As a friend, I must go back and help.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Not to mention Red. Traveler, we gotta go back and save him, right?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Then let's go! We'll need to meet up with Shiki Taishou in secret first.

choices.text: ...but we can't just leave him like this.

talks.objective: Go to the Mystic Onmyou Chamber

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Xinyan, Traveler, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: A general just passed through here, she was leading a team to investigate the area.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Her name is Kujou Sara, she's from the Tenryou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Kujou Sara... Why haven't I heard of her?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I think I remember hearing the name of the Supreme Commander of the Tenryou Commission once. It was a man called Kujou... something. What was it again?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I can't remember his name, but I do remember that Harunosuke played chess with him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Harunosuke sounds like someone important.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Let's save the chit-chat for later, we need to sneak back into the onmyou chamber before anyone sees us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right! We still gotta find Childe! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Alright. Everyone, follow me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Here you are!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: So, is this everyone? You guys had me waiting for quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Let me tell you, you missed out on some incredible action. Quite the pity.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tsk, look at this guy, not a scratch on him.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Hmm? Were you guys worried about me?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hah, you must have a lot of faith in my abilities.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: As a comrade and old rival, you should know that unexpected combat situations are my bread and butter.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Anyway, when the Domain was rearranging itself, the rooms were moving up and down. The monsters were scattered all over the place! *sigh* I had so much fun fighting them these last few days.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I even came across a few replicas. They should contain more power and memories.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Better late than never! Hurry up and fuse with them, Shiki Taishou!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Just a little, huh? Haha, well, if you were worried about me, I'm flattered.

talks.objective: Retrieve a replica of Shiki Taishou

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: The residual power in these replicas is limited, I can only regain a fraction of my memories.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Not enough? Then I guess it's on with the plan. We need to venture deeper into the Domain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... the Domain already rearranged itself. The route we discovered is useless now!

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Don't worry too much, there's a pattern to the rearrangement. I should be able to find the way.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: If I'm not mistaken, we should head in that direction.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second, Paimon has a question! Shiki Taishou, didn't you just say that the power left in the replicas wasn't enough? You still don't have all your memories.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So how would you know if you were heading in the right direction?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Last time, when we followed you through that door, we were sent out of the Domain... which means not all the doors in this place are real!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What if you still can't tell the difference? We might end up somewhere super dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I can completely understand your reservations. Unfortunately, I'm still unable to give you a compelling answer...

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Would you believe it if I said that it's an intuition I have as the overseer here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not... really...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I can see why you're worried Paimon, but our only option is to trust Shiki Taishou as our guide. Otherwise, all we can do is stand here and wait.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Besides, we'll be even more lost if the Domain rearranges itself again!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Hmm, you seem to be more anxious this time around.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Let me guess... trouble on the outside?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: As far as I understand it, Inazuma's situation is still far from stable. A Domain like this would likely fall under the Tenryou Commission's jurisdiction, but they're spread too thinly at present. There's a lot that still falls outside of their control.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Which means that you guys are here as support, and it's very likely that the Tenryou Commission made the request. So, you're receiving their orders.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: In that case, knowing their style, they're probably planning a lethal assault on the Domain to crush everything in their path. If we don't find Shiki Taishou's memories before that happens, then it's possible we never will.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Hence the increased anxiety... right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As expected, you are here to investigate Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this all part of your scheme!?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: It's true, there are indeed matters that I'm investigating, but it's not what you might think. We can talk about that later, let's make sure we deal with our own problems first.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Now then, Traveler, you and I are hardly strangers, and I see no reason for me to lie to you. After arriving in Inazuma, I discovered monster tracks in the surrounding areas, and so I followed them into the Domain.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: It would appear that this place is some sort of combat training ground — there's nothing but fighting and slaughter to be had here. Needless to say, it's been an enjoyable experience for me! I feel quite at home.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: This may come as an unpleasant surprise to Miss Xinyan and Shiki Taishou, but I'm not someone who cares for allegiance and affiliation.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Good and evil, right and wrong, duty and destiny... are these things really so important? Are they really more appealing than the euphoria of battle and close combat?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: You got fightin' in your veins, that's for sure. Well brother, what is it you're tryin' to say...?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Nothing in particular. But I am telling you that we should venture forward bravely. Don't fear the monsters that lie ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: If you're not up to the task, I will happily take your place in crushing all that come before us... then the burden of the slaughter will be mine and mine alone.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Because fighting... is what I'm best at.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: D—Don't look at Paimon! We're going, okay? We're going!

talks.objective: Go deeper into The Brutal Divergence
Retrieve a replica of Shiki Taishou

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: This room is very close to the deepest part of the onmyou chamber. Harunosuke and I... I remember we spent a long time here.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: We would watch martial artists from all over Inazuma. They would drink here and celebrate, shouting: "Now we too have the power to defeat the strongest monsters!"

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: So, you and Kamuna Harunosuke brought samurai here to eradicate monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: That is one possibility... among many.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Perhaps it was all just a ploy by Harunosuke. Maybe recruiting those samurai and ordering them to eradicate the monsters was all in aid of regaining control of the onmyou chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, sounds a lot like something Tartaglia would say...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Hey—? I can have positive assumptions too you know!

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: I'm just trying to make a logical guess. I don't mean to offend anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: My memory is still incomplete, but there's less and less gaps to fill. Soon it should be fully restored.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: What's more, I sense that if we continue forward... we might just come face to face with Harunosuke himself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... this onmyou chamber was built ages ago, wasn't it? Could he have been here all that time!? Whoa...

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Wait — Traveler... You're not about to—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There are things I need to say myself.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Looking at your expressions... This must be something serious.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, we don't need to get too serious though, right? It's eerie enough down here without adding more tension into the mix! Ugh, let Paimon say it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, here goes. In the very beginning, all we heard was that monsters had escaped from a Domain. We came straight here along with samurai from the Tenryou Commission.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When we met you, you didn't know anything about the Domain or where you came from, and we believed you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We had our reservations, but we trusted Xinyan. She took you at your word, and we decided to work together.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's right.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As we ventured deeper and deeper into the Domain, it seemed like the truth was just around the corner...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But even now, we still can't be sure whether this Domain was created for... evil ends.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You never know what you'll find in a chest until you open it, and now we've arrived at that moment, we need to be ready for whatever it contains!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I don't like seein' folks forced into a corner like this... but it's like the Traveler says. We gotta be ready to take responsibility for each other.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I see... So the time has come for me to make a choice.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Until now, I had my doubts about why you had decided to help me throughout all this. Even if we've only spent a few days fighting in each other's company, we should have no reason to hide anything.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I'm afraid that barring new information, it's impossible for me to make any guarantees. I want to believe in Harunosuke, but after all these years, perhaps he's changed... Maybe my memories were never real to begin with.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I am just a shikigami, created by an onmyouji, with nothing more than a few fragmented memories to my name. The four of you are all I have.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Our bond is one of trust. My bond with Harunosuke... is one of responsibility.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: As my creator, I have a duty to follow him... And if he does turn out to be evil, then my destiny will be his to control.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: If I am able, I wish to retain the kindness in my heart until the very end. But a weapon cannot betray its master's will. If he was able to create me, then he is able to control me.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: So... if Harunosuke and I go on to cause harm to others... I trust that you will provide a fitting end for the two of us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *snivel* ...Great, leave all the heart-breaking decisions for us, why don't you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Still, that was an honest and inspiring speech!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Good enough for Paimon! What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Wait, were you two planning this line of questioning all along?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hahaha, not bad at all. You were testing to see whether there were still missing fragments from Shiki Taishou's memory... You've grown, Traveler.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do you mean "testing"! This was an orchestrated collaboration! Successful teamwork!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's like Xinyan said — she has her way of confirming trustworthiness... and we have ours!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, this was a chance to let Shiki Taishou know that even if he's still unsure of the big picture, we're still willing to place our trust in him.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Shiki Taishou refrained from claiming an allegiance... which sounds like the actions of a real comrade to me. Warning us of the potential threat was an act of true responsibility.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I can feel the sincerity.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Well, I'm also a terrible liar... But thank you for opening up to my honesty.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Even good guys lie and manipulate at times... and bad guys have their own doubts and misgivings.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: The fact that you were able to give an answer so cruel to yourself... could only mean that you've truly made up your mind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's just like Xinyan said... Uh... What was it you said again...?

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Haha, could you give me a hint?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, got it! "It's an honest language that touches the truest depths of the heart"!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Word-for-word, huh. Your memory ain't so bad after all, Paimon!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Well then, has our pre-combat session concluded?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: If so, let's get going!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Shiki Taishou, try not to worry — we're here for you.

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I know, and I will do my best not to cause you guys any trouble.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, trouble's fine as long as we can win in the end!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We just need to win one final battle...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Before we get ahead of ourselves, we need to be ready for an even worse scenario. Imagine if this door isn't the way to the innermost depths of the Domain... but just another mechanism...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah! Shut up! Don't jinx it!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hehe, I'm just exploring the what-ifs. There's no guarantee that it won't happen, right?

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: Unfortunately, if that is the case, I don't think I'll be able to prevent it in my current state...

response.speaker: Shiki Taishou
response.text: I'm sorry, but I still don't have full control over this place yet.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Personally, I wouldn't really mind. This place is a combat haven. It can rearrange itself another ten times for all I care.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *whimper* Paimon isn't listening... You can have fun here by yourself when all this is over!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Well, if the Domain does rearrange itself again, you should watch your backs and try and stick together.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: And you'll be off on another solo combat mission, I assume?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Oh, don't worry about me...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I'll be making the most of it!

choices.text: ...will you still be on our side?
There's something I need to ask you.

talks.objective: Go deeper into The Brutal Divergence

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Darn it! We've been kicked out again!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: We need to make sure Red keeps his mouth shut next time... His jinxes are right on the Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's sick of this Domain! Kamuna Harunosuke is a scaredy-cat — he's too afraid to face us!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Still, it's lucky that Red and Shiki Taishou remained inside. This place is crawlin' with Tenryou Commission samurai.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Where could Kamuna be...?)

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Well, same as before I guess, let's wait for the Domain to rearrange and then go and find them.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Until then, we should stay hidden. We wouldn't want the Tenryou Commission to see us wanderin' around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Next time, we HAVE to chase Kamuna out of his hiding spot!
